I have no doubt that it will continue to be of benefit to your State and the nation in the years to come.","explanation":"Distinctive shared reasoning that accumulated experience in state and federal/public roles will continue benefiting the state and nation after resignation."},{"child_excerpt":"Mrs. Eisenhower joins me in best wishes for you and your family for a successful and happy future.
